title: Warm White Brazilian Sausage Stew
description: A hearty and savory Brazilian dish featuring white sauerkraut and tempering chocolate, perfect for a midnight craving. This paleo-friendly stew is cooked in a traditional cazuela vessel.
instructions: Heat the coconut oil in a large cazuela vessel over medium heat.
Add the chopped onions and cook until they are translucent and starting to caramelize.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute, stirring constantly to prevent burning.
Add the sliced Brazilian sausage and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the drained and rinsed white sauerkraut, grated tempering chocolate, salt, and black pepper, stirring to combine.
Pour in the chicken broth and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and cook, covered, for 20 minutes, or until the flavors have melded together and the sausage is cooked through.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
